name: Changzhou Galaxy Century Microelectronics Co.,Ltd.
summary: Changzhou Galaxy Century Microelectronics Co.,Ltd. is an enterprise actively involved in the research, development, production, sales, and servicing of semiconductor devices, operating across both domestic Chinese and international markets. Its product portfolio encompasses a wide array of microelectronic components, including diodes, transistors, bridge rectifiers, LEDs, photocouplers, and linear integrated circuits. The company also extends its expertise through OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) services. These components find extensive application across various sectors such as home appliances, sustainable lighting solutions, network communication, power supplies and charging systems, the automotive industry, smart metering, and industrial automation. Established in 1994, the company is headquartered in Changzhou, China, and operates as a subsidiary of Action Star International Limited.
